text.en:
Placement under the Office of the President of the
Philippines. The National Commission on Indigenous Peoples is hereby placed
under the Office of the President of the Philippines for a period of six (6) months.

Effectivity. This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this Is day of AugusT_ in the year of Our
Lord, Two Thousand and Eight.
Alain Mr. Arago
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
